title: MiniMax M3 Just Leaked... And It's Insane
description:
MiniMax M3 hasn't even launched yet, but the leaks are already getting the AI world excited.

With a new sparse attention architecture and massive speed improvements, MiniMax M3 could become one of the most powerful open-source AI models of 2026.
